steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir in sausage. Cook and stir until sausage is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard any excess grease.
Beat eggs, milk, salt and ground mustard in a large bowl.
Stir Cheddar cheese and sausage into the egg mixture.
Roll out crescent roll dough and place one sheet on the bottom of a large baking dish.
Pour egg mixture into baking dish; place the second sheet of crescent roll dough on top.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight. Allow casserole to come to room temperature for 30 minutes before baking; remove plastic.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bake in the preheated oven until egg is set and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean, about 40 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: K-Dub's Sausage and Egg Casserole
raw_recipe.description: A cheesy blend of sausage and eggs are baked between layers of store-bought crescent roll dough in this make-ahead breakfast casserole.

review.reviewBody: I cut this recipe in half. How I did it was bake it in a 8x8 square pan and just use half the crescent roll dough on the bottom and the other half on the top. I made my own turkey sausage using ground turkey and spices and the milk I used was a mixture of 1% milk and fat free evaporated milk, which made it creamier. I did add some fresh ground pepper to the eggs. This turned out like a mix between a strata and a stuffed breakfast pizza. My family liked this but my husband thought it needed a little more inside the crescent rolls. Next time, I'll throw in some sauteed vegetables and maybe some spices. Good base recipe to make your own.

This is delicious! I scaled down the recipe for 2. I used 1 can of the dough on the bottom (so I didn't roll it, I just patted it in) and baked it open-face. I used the whole amount of sausage, the whole amount of cheese, 3 eggs and 1 cup of milk. I baked it in a 8x8 pan for 40 minutes and it turned out perfectly done. Eggs were soft but set and not at all runny. This is a keeper!!

I wanted to make this in a 9 x 13 pan and made some lucky guesses on what to increase! I used 12 eggs, 4 cups of milk and 2 cans of crescent rolls. I kept all of the other ingredients as listed. One can of crescent rolls was perfect for the bottom; I could stretch it to fit the bottom. The top one was a little tricky as it sort of just floated on the eggs. There was also enough mixture for an extra 4x4 casserole - perfect for a low carb guest. It all came out great with no leftovers!

This is a great breakfast casserole! My daughter and my co-workers really enjoyed it and wanted the recipe. I used half mild and half maple flavored Jimmy Dean sausage, half mild & half Sharp cheddar cheese, lemon pepper seasoning & a zesty season blend. The crust cooked fast and the middle of the casserole was slow to cook. I reduced the temperature to 300 and put the casserole on the lower rack to cook an additional 10 minutes. I still love this dish and plan to do it again but substitute condensed milk with 1 cup of milk instead of the 2 cups of milk.

Love it. Only changes I made were to use an 8" x 8" greased casserole dish and used only 1 cup of milk. I only needed 1 can of crescent rolls, split half on bottom and half on top. Baked at 350 for 45 minutes; then covered top loosely with foil to keep it from over cooking, and baked 15 more minutes. My new special occasions breakfast casserole.

I also cut it it half and added Mushrooms, red Peppers and a small onion that I first cooked in butter. I also doubled the cheese and used Sausage links.Thanks!
Yummy!

This was so awesome! I cut the recipe in half for my square pan. It was perfect! Change nothing! I have to say though that I only refrigerated this for about 4 hours, and I used up some Monterey jack cheese instead of cheddar. I baked in my convection oven at 350 and it took exactly 30 minutes. Rock on. K-Dub, you're a genius.

Great NFL football morning tailgate crowd favorite.
For us, baking for 50 to 55 minutes seems to work at sea level. 2 cups of shredded cheese improves it too.
Couldn't get the powdered mustard to mix, it would ball up and just not jive, so I used a tsp of hot dog mustard instead.
I use Jimmy Dean Sausage.
After slicing out a serving, country gravy over it is a real plus.

This was good but I halved it - using 5 eggs. I felt it needed a “lil’ more” than just meat and cheese so I added a chopped onion and 1/2 red bell pepper. I also seasoned the eggs with some garlic and onion powder (approx 1:2 tsp) in addition to the dry mustard. Bake time pretty close as written….almost 55 min in my oven and that was halving it. Either way, people liked and leftovers reheated well! Thanks K-Dub!
I made this with hot sausage and red chili flakes. Great little kick of heat.

YUMMY! I used 1 roll of crescents in an 8x8 pan, but kept everything else the same b/c I wanted a nice, thick casserole...worked perfectly! Great flavor and couldn't have been simplier...will be making this again! Thanks for sharing. :)
We liked the concept of this dish, but I think next time we'll use spicy sausage to give it a little more flavor.
I've made this many times when we have had overnight guests... it's always a hit!
i will definitely make this again. it even heated up ok a couple days later. I would recommend a couple more eggs however.

We actually made this recipe with cubed portuguese sausage that we did not cook ahead of time....and it was fantastic!! I was brave enough to change the recipe after reading other reviews. Definitely a Christmas morning hit!
Great and easy recipe. The only thing I did differently is only used one package of crescent rolls. That seems to be enough. Everyone loved this recipe. I end up making it at least once a week!
We make this every Christmas morning. The family loves it and we change up the recipe sometimes.
Very yummy! I had to cook it at least 10 min longer than the recipe says because it was still too runny...but no worries. Will surely make it again!
This was awesome!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Took to work today and it was gone in a heartbeat. Making tomorrow for family.

Super easy and super tasty!! I made this the day before, let it sit in the fridge overnight and popped it in the oven the next morning. Great for my kids before school! Mine did take almost an hour to cook...
